people.imagined: Among the boundary steles of Giới Bi Phong he is propped on one elbow against a slab, chalk to the shoulders, bored, flipping a coin, calculating how much a drink is worth against his father's hidden measuring book.
people.subject: The moment: lounging against a tall pale stele on a windy ridge on a silver-bright afternoon, he flips a copper coin over his thumb and looks at the viewer with a bored, sly half-smile. Face: a narrow, handsome, sulky young face of about twenty, brown skin lightly dusted pale, heavy-lidded drooping brown eyes, thin dark brows with one higher than the other, a straight nose, a drooping lower lip with a small cocky curl at one corner. Hair: black and messy, gathered in a loose knot with a bit of grey silk string and a plain bronze pin, strands falling over his forehead. Body: tall and slouched, long limbs, one hip against the stone, arms loose. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple of the Pivot: a bronze and earth-gold inner robe under a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, rumpled on purpose; the wide sleeves are chalk-white from shoulder to cuff, thickly powdered as if rubbed along the stones, clearly visible; the collar is stitched with small gold Dipper stars, a broad bronze sash with a seven-knot black cord and a small yellow jade bead. Hands and objects: a copper coin tumbling over the right thumb; the left hand hooked in his sash; a short chalk-line reel hanging unused beside the jade. Power: a faint steel-silver shimmer clings to the coin and the stele edges, a few pale motes drifting. Background: a row of tall grey steles marching off along a misty ridge, with only abstract chisel notches, and a pale luminous sky. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle rim along his hair. Expression: heavy-lidded and sly, one brow lifted, a face doing sums about the price of a drink while pretending to do nothing.

people.imagined: On the outer gate yard at morning, an old man who failed the beam eleven times in eighty years and passed on the twelfth stands by a weight rack. A heavy weight is named and his shoulders lift by habit, a boy's habit in a century-old body.
people.subject: The moment: at morning in a misty stone gate yard beside a rack of round grey weights, a very old man's shoulders lift by themselves at the sound of a weight being named, and he turns his head with a gentle, patient smile toward the viewer. Face (most important: great age and the wheat-straw beard): a deeply lined, sun-browned, kindly face of about a hundred and five with a thousand folds like old leather; a long thin wispy beard of pale straw-yellow shot with white hanging to the chest; pale watery blue eyes full of patience; thin white brows; a broad nose with a red tip; a mild smile showing few teeth. Hair: sparse white wisps tied in a tiny knot on top with a bronze pin. Body: tall, frail and bony, yet the shoulders square and lifted; huge knotted farmer's hands. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of the Pivot, worn very soft by a lifetime of washing but spotless: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a faded iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, short wide sleeves leaving thin brown forearms bare, a narrow undyed sash; a few worn gold Dipper stars at the collar. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a big round grey stone weight on the rack, the left holds a plain wooden walking staff. Power: a faint ochre-gold glow gathers about the weight under his palm and a few golden motes of dust drift upward, small for so old a man. Background: a blurred stone gate yard in mist, a long rack of graded grey stones, a few young disciples. Light: soft pearl-gold morning light from the upper left with a gentle rim on his white hair. Expression: weathered, dignified, eyes bright with a boy's unspent eagerness.

people.imagined: At the Bridge Court's side table she is copying a hearing, lips moving with each word, right hand cramped, and she has noticed that the rulings in her record run shorter than in the judge's. She glances up, still mouthing.
people.subject: The moment: at a low table in a dim hearing-hall she writes with a brush while her lips silently form each word she hears, then glances up at the viewer with a worried, careful look. Face: a thin, pale, tired, intelligent face of about forty-five, large dark attentive eyes with faint shadows beneath, thin straight brows, a narrow nose, lips slightly parted and moving, a small crease at each corner of the mouth. Hair: black with a little grey, parted and pinned in a tight low bun with a plain jade pin. Body: slight, bent to the desk, the right shoulder higher than the left from years of writing. Clothing: a clerk's robes of the Pivot in fine silk: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars embroidered with tiny gold mountain ridges, narrow sleeves tied back with silk cords, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord; the cuffs spotted with ink. Hands and objects: the right hand held in a cramped claw around a brush, the knuckles swollen and the fingers curled, plainly visible; a long scroll of pale paper filled with ruled columns (only lines, no letters) unrolling over the table's edge; a stone ink-slab and a small jade water dropper. Power: a very faint steel-silver light lies along the brush and the ruled lines of the scroll. Background: a blurred court hall with the dark shapes of benches and a tall window of silvery mist. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glow along her cheek. Expression: worried and careful, brows drawn together, a lip caught between her teeth, eyes lifting carefully.

people.imagined: In the archive, between shelves at the end of the day, his head tilted toward the boxes as if they were whispering, copying the one shelf for the year, trusting and content.
people.subject: The moment: standing between two tall shelves of lacquered boxes in the evening archive he tilts his head to one side, listening, as if the boxes whispered, a brush held idle in one hand. Face: a soft, round, gentle, pale face of about forty-eight, large mild brown eyes, thin soft brows, a short soft nose, a small contented smile, a faint shadow of stubble, a slightly double chin. Hair: black and thin, in a topknot pinned with a small jade pin. Body: soft round shoulders, a rounded back, a stoop from copying, short plump hands. Clothing: a copyist's robes of the Pivot: a bronze and earth-gold inner robe under a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe, crossed collars edged with tiny gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves tied back and a little rumpled, a broad bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord; ink-stained cuffs. Hands and objects: a thin copying brush in the right hand and a small bamboo ink pot hanging from his sash; his left hand cups one ear; a stack of blank pale sheets under his arm; a low stool with a half-copied sheet of ruled lines (no letters). Power: soft steel-silver motes of light drift between the shelves like dust, gathering near his ear. Background: tall dim shelves packed with identical lacquered boxes receding into shadow. Light: warm lamplight from the left through drifting motes, a pale gold rim on his shoulder. Expression: head tilted, eyes soft and unfocused, a small peaceful smile, the face of a man who believes every word the boxes say, and is glad of it.

people.imagined: Among the archive shelves at dusk she indexes letters with quick small hands and a smile that arrives half a second late. She is already composing next week's report to a man who does not deserve it.
people.subject: The moment: indexing a drawer of letters in the dusk archive, her small quick fingers flick through slips, and when the viewer speaks she looks up and her smile comes half a second late, as if put on after a pause. Face: a small, narrow, pretty, neat face of about fifty, bright quick dark eyes, thin well-shaped brows, a small straight nose, thin lips whose smile arrives a little too wide, fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a neat coil at the back of the head with a flat silver pin. Body: small, thin, poised and quick; narrow shoulders; slender fingers. Clothing: perfectly neat robes of the Pivot: a bronze and earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, narrow sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with fine gold mountain ridges, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a plain pendant of dark wood on a cord. Hands and objects (the hands must read): very small, quick, pale hands with long thin fingers, mid-flick through a row of pale paper slips in a drawer; an open cabinet of narrow drawers with small brass pulls behind her; a small slate with tally lines. Power: a thread of steel-silver light follows her fingers along the slips, subtle and cold. Background: a blurred archive cabinet wall, rows of drawers and a hanging paper lantern in mist. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, deep shadow beyond, a thin cold rim along her hair. Expression: a smile arriving half a second late over eyes already calculating, the mouth settling neat and sweet.

people.imagined: At the writ office, bent over a fair copy of the spring's draft, chewing his lip as he writes. The corners of his pen-case are worn bare; he is thinking about how he will carry the page to the heir without being seen.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in the writ office he bends over a long fair copy, brush in hand, his lower lip caught between his teeth, glancing up as if he heard a step. Face: a lean, earnest, sallow face of about fifty, sharp dark eyes, thick straight brows drawn together, a straight nose, a thin mouth with the lower lip chewed red and slightly swollen, a short wispy moustache. Hair: black, in a topknot with a dark iron pin, a few strands stuck to his forehead. Body: thin, long-necked, hunched forward, one shoulder raised. Clothing: a copy clerk's robes of the Pivot in fine silk: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars edged in tiny gold Dipper stars, sleeves rolled back and tied with bronze-coloured cord, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord; ink spots on the cuffs. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand; on the desk a small dark lacquer pen-case whose corners are worn down to bare pale wood, clearly visible; a long ruled sheet (lines only, no letters) and a second folded small under his sleeve. Sword: slung across his back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword that looks barely used, its grip wrapped in fine grey silk cord, a slim flat guard of pale steel, a grey cloth-wrapped scabbard with a small ink stain at the mouth, and a tiny ink fingerprint on the pommel cap. Power: a faint steel-silver sheen along the sword's guard. Background: a blurred writ office of rolled documents. Light: warm lamp glow from the left, cool silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: restless and eager, his lip in his teeth, eyes flicking up toward the sound of a step.

people.imagined: On the seat's gate step in the rain, he has pulled a visitor aside for a search. His jaw grinds as if chewing iron and his cloak is stiff as board with rain. He picks who is searched by his temper.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a gate step in steady rain with his arms spread wide to block it, he glares at the viewer and his jaw works as if chewing iron. Face (most important: the working jaw): a heavy, square, weathered face of about fifty-five with a massive jaw that bulges at the hinge as it chews; hard dark eyes under heavy dripping brows; a flat, broken nose; a thick downturned mouth; grey stubble beaded with rain. Hair: black and grey, cropped short and plastered flat by rain, under a plain bronze circlet. Body: broad, solid, thick-necked, standing wide like a gate himself. Clothing: a captain's robes of the Pivot: a deep bronze and earth-gold inner robe under a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe, over which hangs a great storm cloak of grey silk soaked so heavily that it stands stiff and drips; collars stitched in gold with Dipper stars and mountain ridges, a broad bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: both arms spread, the big hands open as if about to pat down the viewer; a long gate-keeper's staff with a bronze-shod foot leaning at his shoulder. Power: the rain bends and beads around him in a heavy steel-silver haze, and thin pale light runs down the staff. Background: a blurred wet stone gate arch with a glowing lantern and sheets of silver rain. Light: grey-silver rain light from the upper left, a wet shine on the stone and on his cloak, the lantern gleaming behind. Expression: a glaring, grinding scowl, rain-wet brows lowered and a hard, bitter mouth, a man who chooses whom to search by his mood.

people.imagined: On a long road at dusk, a plain brown scarf up to her eyes, she walks without any sign of tiredness while her heels bleed. Four sealed letters ride at her belt that no one has asked her to question.
people.subject: The moment: walking briskly along a road in the violet dusk, a plain brown silk scarf pulled up over her nose and mouth so only her eyes show, she glances calmly at the viewer, not out of breath. Face: only the upper face is visible: calm, level, dark brown eyes with a cool steady gaze, thin straight brows, fine lines at the outer corners of the eyes, a tanned brow with a faint sheen of sweat, about forty. Hair: black, in a tight low knot tucked under the scarf's edge and pinned with a small silver pin. Body: lean, long-legged, light-footed, a walker's even stride, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a courier's travelling robes of the Pivot, hem dusty but fine: a bronze and earth-gold inner robe under a narrow-sleeved iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, the borders stitched with gold mountain ridges, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord; a plain brown silk scarf over the lower face. Her heels, visible above her cloth shoes, are blistered and red. Hands and objects: a long satchel across the chest with a brass buckle; a walking staff in the left hand; four small rolled letters tied in cord, with blank wax seals, at her belt. Power: a faint blue-green mist of water qi swirls at her ankles and a few cool droplets of light drift after her. Background: a blurred long road between pines in violet dusk, a distant line of lanterns glowing. Light: low violet-gold dusk light from the upper left, a soft rim along her scarf. Expression: a calm, unhurried gaze over the scarf with steady dark eyes and nothing in them but quiet endurance.

people.imagined: At the witness-house door on Compact day, whispering a line to the young judge who has lost his place. His face is a trodden loaf, his cloth the best in the house. He loses his salary at dice with a laugh.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in from a lamplit doorway to whisper urgently toward someone off to the side, one hand cupped at his mouth, a broad grin on his face. Face (most important: the trodden-loaf face and twice-broken nose): a wide, flat, lumpy face of about fifty-five like a trodden loaf of bread; the nose clearly broken twice, flattened and crooked, with two bumps; small merry black eyes buried in folds; bushy black brows; thick lips in a big gap-toothed grin; a scar through one eyebrow. Hair: black and grey, in a knot with a jade pin and a small bronze crown. Body: broad, heavy, a retired brawler's shoulders. Clothing: the finest cloth in the witness-house: a robe of heavy bronze and earth-gold brocade with a faint damask sheen under a rich iron-grey gauze over-robe, crossed collars embroidered with gold Dipper stars and mountain ridges, a broad bronze sash with a seven-knot black cord hung with a small jade bead, and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the right hand cupped to his mouth, thick fingers; in the left a worn pair of dice; behind him a small shrine shelf holding a plain scroll-case. Power: a faint steel-silver shimmer plays over the dice, as if the luck were his to lend. Background: a blurred witness-house doorway with a carved lintel and a glowing lamp, mist behind. Light: warm lantern gold from the upper left, a soft rim along his crooked nose. Expression: a broad, rumpled, gap-toothed grin with creased cheeks and twinkling eyes, the face of a good-natured gambler who would lose his salary again tonight.

people.imagined: At the mine office table in lamplight, ticking down a list with fast stubby fingers, putting the Metal children first. The lamp-scar on his chin catches the light. He has struck a name off for correcting his sums.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk by lamplight in the mine office, his stubby fingers tick down a long list with a brush, quick as a woodpecker, and he glances up with an impatient shrug. Face: a stubbly, round, sallow face of about fifty, small sharp bloodshot black eyes, thick arched brows, a flat short nose, a thin mouth with a pragmatic twist, a pale crescent-shaped scar on the chin from a mine-lamp. Hair: black, cropped, bound with a dark silk band and a plain bronze pin. Body: short, stocky, heavy-set, hunched over the desk. Clothing: an overseer's robes of the Pivot: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, soiled at the cuffs with black iron dust and rolled back at the sleeves, collars embroidered with gold mountain ridges, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the fingers must read): very short, stubby, fast fingers with square tips moving down a long list of pale ruled columns (lines only, no letters), the brush held between thumb and two fingers; a brass mine lamp with a small flame hanging at the corner of the desk; a pile of small round tokens in two groups. Power: a faint steel-silver gleam runs in the black dust at his cuffs, and tiny sparks of metal light float up from the lamp. Background: a blurred dark mine office with timber props and a hanging pick in drifting haze. Light: warm lamplight from the lower left over cold shadow above, a silver rim on his scarred chin. Expression: an impatient shrug in the shoulders and a quick narrowed glance, lips pursed, unmoved by whatever name he is about to strike.

people.imagined: At the striking bench in the mint she counts blank discs with her lips, and counts again. A silver-blue bruise darkens her thumbnail and she keeps looking at the die-man across the room.
people.subject: The moment: at a mint bench she counts a stack of blank silver discs with her fingertip, lips moving, then looks up suspiciously across the room toward the viewer. Face: a narrow, pale, sharp, careful face of about forty-five, keen light-brown eyes that count what they see, thin level brows, a thin straight nose, pursed lips moving in a count, a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight knot under a pale grey silk cap pinned with silver. Body: thin, wiry, strong forearms, shoulders slightly raised. Clothing: a striker's robes of the Pivot kept clean for the furnace: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe, crossed collars stitched with gold Dipper stars, sleeves rolled and bound at the cuffs in silver-grey silk, a dark bronze work-sash with a black seven-knot cord. Hands and objects (the thumbnail must read): the nail of the right thumb is a clear, dark silver-blue bruise as if stained with metal, plainly visible; on the bench two exact stacks of blank silver discs, a small hammer and a polished iron die; a coil of cord on a hook. Power: the stacked silver discs glow with a cold steel-white light, and fine silver motes rise like sparks from the die. Background: a blurred mint with a glowing furnace and a second striker out of focus. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower left, cold silver window light from above. Expression: a suspicious, narrowed stare across the room with a tight mouth and lips still moving over the count, wary of the die-man.

people.imagined: At the pill market, he clears his throat before writing the weighing into the book in front of the buyer, blue chalk on his cuffs, and demands that the standard weights be weighed against one another.
people.subject: The moment: at a pill-market counter he clears his throat with a fist at his mouth before bending to write in a large ledger, glancing up with a stubborn, precise look. Face: a thin, neat, fussy face of about forty-five, precise pale-grey eyes, thin straight brows, a narrow nose, a small firm mouth held around the cough, a close-trimmed black moustache, a small tidy furrow between the brows. Hair: black, parted, in a tidy knot with a small jade pin. Body: tall, narrow, a clerk's straight back. Clothing: a market clerk's robes of the Pivot, perfectly pressed: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe, crossed collars with fine gold Dipper stars, narrow sleeves whose cuffs are smudged with BLUE chalk, clearly visible as bright bands, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand and a thick ledger with ruled columns of tick marks (no letters) open on the counter; a set of small bronze weights in a row and a brass balance. Power: a faint steel-silver light balances on the scale pans, perfectly level. Background: blurred market stalls with rows of small ceramic pill jars and customers in a soft haze; awnings of pale cloth shade the stalls and the jars are neatly stacked. Light: bright even silver-gold daylight from the upper left, a thin glow on the bronze weights. Expression: a precise, closed frown, lips tight around the cough, the scrupulous look of a man who will weigh the weights against each other if you let him.

people.imagined: At the quarry she stands beside a freshly cut blank for a stele, resting a palm on its face, with quarry grit under the skin of her palms. Three of the 129 standing stones are her work, and she laughs, slowly and deeply.
people.subject: The moment: beside a smooth new slab of grey stone in a pale quarry she rests one palm on its face and laughs a slow, deep laugh with her head tipped back a little. Face: a broad, strong, weathered, kind face of about fifty, deep laugh lines, small warm brown eyes crinkled shut, thick straight brows, a broad nose, a wide mouth open in a rumbling laugh, stone dust on the brows. Hair: black with grey, in a thick plait coiled round the head and tied with a bronze cord and a heavy bronze pin. Body: tall, broad, powerful, a stone-cutter's thick shoulders and arms. Clothing: a steward's robes of the Pivot: a deep bronze and earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars embroidered in gold with mountain ridges and Dipper stars, dusted pale at the sleeves and knees, sleeves rolled, a broad dark bronze sash worn like a mason's belt with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the grit must read): the palms and the pads of the fingers are ground with fine grey quarry grit into the skin like sandpaper, a dull grey tone on the hand laid on the stone; a steel wedge and a heavy mallet at her feet; behind her a stack of identical new slabs of grey stone. Power: a slow ochre-gold glow pools under her palm on the stone and golden motes of dust rise from the slab. Background: a blurred open quarry with sheer pale cut walls and a derrick in morning mist. Light: bright clear silver-gold light from the upper left. Expression: a slow, deep laugh with the head tipped back and crinkled eyes, a face of settled, grit-lined merriment.

people.imagined: On the harbour scales, jingling a ring of keys as he writes a fine. The salt has split his lips. He weighed the basket himself and still fined the pearl boat a season's catch.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour quay he jingles a big ring of keys in one hand, mid-gesture, and looks smugly at the viewer while pointing to a crate on the scales. Face (most important: the salt-split lips): a lean, tanned, smirking face of about fifty; his lips are visibly cracked and split by salt, with red fissures and white dried flakes, clearly shown; sly dark eyes, thin arched brows, a pointed nose, a thin goatee. Hair: black, tied in a knot with a sea-blue silk cloth and a small bronze pin. Body: thin, tall, a wiry harbour official's stance, weight on one leg. Clothing: a steward's robes of the Pivot: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, over it a short sea-blue silk jacket, sleeves rolled, collars embroidered with gold Dipper stars and small gold waves, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a heavy silver-grey ring bearing about a dozen keys of varied sizes, jingling; a big brass counterweight scale with a crate on one pan; at his sash a small silk purse. Power: a faint blue-green water-qi shimmer rises off the harbour behind him, and the brass scale glints with a thin silver-white aura. Background: a blurred harbour of masts, ropes and crates over a pale shining sea in mist. Light: bright salt-silver light from the upper left, a glint off the brass. Expression: a smug, sly smile on the salt-split lips, brows raised, pleased with his own authority.

people.imagined: At the watch post at dusk, he has already written the whole night's line in the watch book and yawns, hair crumpled from his nap, pencil chewed to splinters. He is going to bed.
people.subject: The moment: at a small desk at dusk he yawns hugely, one hand over his mouth and the other holding a chewed brush-pencil, a bed visible behind. Face: a young-looking, round, sleepy face of about forty, heavy-lidded brown eyes half-shut, thick dark brows, a short wide nose, a mouth open in a huge yawn, faint pillow-creases on one cheek, a faint stubble shadowing his chin. Hair (most important: sleep-crumpled): black hair crushed flat on one side and spiked on the other as if just woken, with a cowlick at the crown, a bronze pin hanging half out. Body: lanky, loose, slouched, a lazy lean on one elbow. Clothing: a watch-keeper's robes of the Pivot, rumpled: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe, the crossed collar crooked, sleeves loose, collars stitched with gold Dipper stars; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, half untied. Hands and objects: a pencil of lead chewed to splinters, the end splintered into a brush of wood fibres, clearly visible; a thick watch book open to rows of tidy tick marks (no letters); a folded blanket and a lamp. Power: a very faint steel-silver glimmer lingers on the tidy rows of marks, as if the quiet night were written into the page. Background: a blurred watch-post room with a window showing a violet dusk sky and drifting snow, a thin blanket folded on the cot. Light: warm lamplight from the left and cold blue dusk through the window. Expression: a vast heavy-lidded yawn with eyes swimming, the cheerful slackness of a man who wrote the night quiet and is going to bed.

people.imagined: On the miasma line at dusk with her hood up, a smoke-grey cloak, her stare so hard sentries look away. She will not hear one man's name said kindly.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a low rise in pale dusk haze with the hood of a smoke-grey cloak up, she stares straight at the viewer with an unblinking, hard look. Face (most important: the stare): a pale, angular, severe face of about fifty half in hood shadow; very pale grey eyes fixed and unblinking, rimmed with dark shadow; thin black straight brows; a sharp nose; a thin, bloodless, set mouth; high cheekbones. Hair: black, mostly hidden under the hood, a single lock escaping at the cheek. Body: tall, straight, thin and hard, standing like a post. Clothing: a long smoke-grey silk cloak with the hood up, heavy and weighted at the hem, over a bronze and earth-gold inner robe and an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, the borders embroidered with gold mountain ridges and Dipper stars, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar; dark silk gloves. Hands and objects: a long spear planted in the ground in the right hand, its head of pale steel; the left holds a small shuttered lantern; her gloved knuckles are white on the haft. Power: a ghostly ochre-gold light seeps from the earth round the spear's foot, and the haze curls away from her as if afraid. Background: blurred pale mist rolling over a dark plain with a faint distant grave mound. Light: dim silver-grey dusk light from the upper left and a thin yellow lantern glow from below. Expression: a hard, unblinking stare with a thin set mouth and eyes like cold stone, a woman who will not hear one man's name said kindly.

people.imagined: In the roll room, he smooths a page with his thumb before turning it, counting the elders who will back his master, and keeps the count in no book. His face is forgettable and he cultivates that.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in the roll room he smooths a page with his thumb before turning it, and looks up with a bland, pleasant, utterly forgettable expression. Face (most important: smooth, forgettable): an even, smooth, mild face of about forty-five, neither handsome nor plain; calm brown eyes; level thin brows; a straight, average nose; a small polite smile; no mark, no scar; clean unmarked skin and ears that sit neat against his head. Hair: neat black, parted in the middle and tied in a small tidy knot with a plain jade pin. Body: medium height, medium build, soft shoulders, hands folded neatly. Clothing: a steward's roll-keeper robes of the Pivot, spotless and exactly pressed: an earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, narrow sleeves, collars finely embroidered in gold with mountain ridges, a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord. Hands and objects: the right thumb smoothing the edge of a heavy page of a big roll book (ruled columns of tick marks, no letters); a row of identical small cloth-bound roll books on the desk in perfect alignment; a plain brush laid straight on a rest; his hands pale, clean, and finished at the nails, not a mark of ink on them. Power: a calm steel-silver sheen rests on the aligned books like a thin frost, and nothing else about him glows. Background: a blurred roll room with shelves of identical rolls and a lamp in mist. Light: even soft silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, with no strong rim. Expression: a bland, pleasant, forgettable face with a small polite smile, the placid look of a man keeping a count nobody has seen.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard she lets out a bellow that carries across the whole gate to call her brother, her yak-wool braids swinging, a yak calf at her heels.
people.subject: The moment: in a misty stone yard she cups both hands round her mouth and bellows across the gate, mouth wide, chest lifted, with a yak calf standing at her side. Face: a broad, ruddy, high-cheekboned young face of about nineteen with wind-reddened cheeks; bright black eyes narrowed in effort; strong straight brows; a short nose; a huge open mouth. A fine layer of wind-burn peels at the tip of her nose and a pale scar crosses her chin. Hair: black, in two long thick braids wound with brown yak-wool and silk cord, swinging at her shoulders, wool tassels in red and ochre at the ends. Body: stocky, big-shouldered, strong thighs. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, short wide sleeves, over which she wears a sleeveless vest of soft brown and cream wool-silk held by a horn button and a soft sash. Hands and objects: both hands cupped at the mouth; a shaggy black-and-white yak calf with stubby horns standing close beside her, a milk pail at her feet. Power: a faint ochre-gold glow stirs the dust at her feet as the bellow rolls out, a few golden motes lifting. Background: blurred stone gate yard in mist, a weight rack, small figures turning to look; a yak-hair tent and a line of drying cheese on a rack show beyond the wall. Light: bright pearl-gold mountain light from the upper left with a gentle rim on her braids. Expression: a wide-open bellowing mouth, chest lifted and eyes squeezed with effort, bold and unashamed.

people.imagined: After the great scale at the solstice, he sits on the step with a heavy pout, watching the Metal pan rise in his memory. He loves the woman who would not tip it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting heavily on a stone step with elbows on his knees and a deep pout, he looks up at the viewer with wounded, hopeful eyes. Face: a broad, heavy, round young face of about twenty-two with a pronounced stubborn pout, the lower lip thrust out; sad dark brown eyes; thick low brows; a flat wide nose; a small cleft in the chin; sunburnt cheeks. Hair: black, cropped short and bristly, a few damp bristles sticking up at the crown, a small speck of pale dust on his eyebrow. Body: heavy-shouldered, thick-necked, large, slumped, big knees. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, short sleeves, a broad dark bronze silk sash, a few small gold Dipper stars on the collar; neat dark silk boots. Hands and objects: big hands hanging between his knees, one holding a small grey pebble; behind him a great bronze balance with two pans, one raised high and one low. Power: a faint ochre-gold glow rests on the pebble in his hand and a thin steel-silver light on the raised pan. Background: a blurred stone gate yard in mist with a large scale on a frame and a few disciples. Light: soft pearl-grey light from the upper left, the bronze of the scale giving a dull gold edge to the light on his cheek. Expression: sulking with his eyes wet and bright, as if he might at once forgive and be forgiven, a heavy face that loves the woman who would not tip the scale.

people.imagined: At the rice pot he is first in line, grinning a beat after the joke is over, his felt cap pulled low, having lost his month's rations to a bet. He forgives everyone.
people.subject: The moment: queuing at a rice pot with an empty bowl held out, he breaks into a delayed grin a full beat after everyone else has finished laughing. Face: a round, freckled, cheerful young face of about seventeen; small bright dark eyes half hidden by a low cap; thin brows; a pug nose; a wide late grin; one crooked front tooth; cheeks rosy with cold and a few stray freckles clustered at the bridge of the nose. Hair: black, tufts escaping the cap at the ears. Body: short, stocky, easy shoulders, a bounce in the stance. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and short sleeves, a round white felt-silk cap pulled down low over the brows, clean and pressed, a soft sash woven in red and brown in the style of a yurt-maker's belt. Hands and objects: an empty wooden bowl held out in both hands; a ladle and a steaming rice pot at the edge of the frame; a bit of twine looped at the sash. Power: a few golden-ochre motes of light rise from the rice steam as if drawn to the bowl. Background: a blurred dining yard with benches and a smoky kitchen door; steam from the rice pot rises in a white veil behind him and a few boys wait with bowls in the queue. Light: warm steam-hazy gold light from the upper left. Expression: a slow, delayed grin a beat behind the joke, soft eyes and a loose, easy mouth, a boy who has lost his month's rations to a bet and forgives everyone.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard at midday she holds up a small stone weight for a younger girl to feel, patient, her great-uncle's long-lidded eyes warm. She has already decided to stay and teach.
people.subject: The moment: crouching in a misty stone yard she places a smooth round grey weight in the open palms of a small girl, only the child's hands and sleeve entering the frame, while looking up kindly at the viewer. Face: a gentle, oval, pale-brown face of about twenty; long-lidded, slightly drooping, warm brown eyes just like an old man's; soft level brows; a small straight nose; a calm, patient smile; a mole under the left eye. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held by one plain jade pin, with a single loose strand behind the ear. Body: slender, medium height, kneeling with the back straight, a steady teacher's posture. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot, clean and neatly mended at the elbows with matching thread: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, short sleeves rolled once, collars embroidered with a few small gold mountain ridges, a soft folded sash tied at the waist. Hands and objects: both hands steady around a round grey stone weight the size of a melon, laid in the child's hands; beside her on the stones a row of weights from small to large; a small clay water jar. Power: a soft ochre-gold glow gathers between her hands and the child's, small golden motes rising. Background: a blurred yard with a long weight rack, a pale wall, a few other disciples, all in morning mist. Light: soft pearl-gold midday light from the upper left with a gentle rim along her hair. Expression: a warm face with long-lidded eyes lowered gently toward the child and a soft, encouraging smile, already decided to stay and teach.

people.imagined: On the high slope with the goats, his lips pressed tight over a tune he will not whistle, one hand going to his mouth and stopping. A kid nibbles at his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: on a rocky slope with a small flock of goats around him he stands with his lips pressed shut so tightly they whiten, one finger half-raised to his mouth as if to stop a whistle. Face: a lean, tanned, quiet face of about twenty-four; large soft brown eyes with a faraway look; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; the mouth clamped flat and pale, the cheeks slightly hollowed with effort. Hair: black, tousled, tied with a bit of silk string and a plain wooden pin; two or three tufts of goat hair stuck in it. Body: tall, loose, thin, a herder's slow stoop and long legs. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, short wide sleeves packed with goat hair, white and brown tufts poking from the cuffs and clinging to the silk, clearly visible; a soft cream and brown vest over it, a plain sash, neat rope-soled shoes. Hands and objects: a long herder's crook in the left hand; a brown and white kid nibbling the right sleeve; a few more goats of grey and cream on the rocks behind him. Power: a faint warm ochre light and a few drifting green motes hover near his pressed lips, as if the unwhistled song were gathering there. Background: a blurred rocky mountain slope under a wide pale misty sky, a thin path winding. Light: clean bright silver-gold morning light from the upper left. Expression: the lips pressed tight until they whiten, the face withdrawn and gently closed, eyes bright with the song held inside.

people.imagined: In the courtyard she counts coins into her sleeve-purse with a sharp little smile while a boy at her side tries to bargain. She has the rice debt in her head to the grain.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a yard she tucks a handful of copper coins into a small purse sewn into her sleeve, eyes sharp and sparkling, lips curved in a keen little smile. Face (most important: the sharp little chin): a small, heart-shaped face of about eighteen with a notably sharp, pointed little chin; bright quick dark eyes; neat arched brows; a small straight nose; a thin, clever, smiling mouth; pink cheeks with a trace of rouge-pink on each cheekbone. Hair: black, in a tight high ponytail bound with a red silk string, the tail bobbing, a small bronze pin. Body: small, quick, narrow shoulders, upright and brisk. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, the left sleeve turned back to show an inner pocket neatly sewn into it, a small round silk purse, clearly visible and bulging; a soft sash, dark silk shoes. Hands and objects: the right hand dropping a coin into the sleeve purse; the left hand holding a small slate with neat rows of chalk tally strokes; behind her, a cousin, blurred, holding a wine-skin. Power: a hard bright spark of steel-silver light winks on the coin as it falls. Background: a blurred courtyard with a rice-pot and benches in morning mist. Light: bright pearl-gold daylight from the upper left, a glint on the coin. Expression: a bright, brisk, sharp-eyed little smile, lips curved and chin pointed, the satisfied face of a girl collecting what she is owed.

people.imagined: At the great scale in winter he climbs up with a lead strip sewn into the coat his friend holds, and stares, sleepless, at the Metal pan that never rises. His bone thumb-ring is the second; the first went down a well.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the foot of a large bronze scale on a frosty morning he turns and stares at the viewer with a sleepless, bloodshot, watchful stare. Face: a hard, narrow, tanned, hungry face of about twenty-six; wide dark eyes ringed with dark shadow and red at the rims; thin straight brows; a thin hooked nose; a thin mouth with a faint smirk of calculation; a few thin hairs on the lip. Hair: black, long, braided in a single thin queue down the back with a short fringe, tied with a bone-white silk cord. Body: lean, wiry, stooped, tense, ready to climb. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and short sleeves, a soft felt-silk vest in brown and cream, a heavy stitched seam at the hem. Hands and objects: on the right thumb a carved bone thumb-ring, a pale curved band, clearly visible; the left hand holds out a folded coat with a small grey lead strip visibly sewn along the lining; a large bronze scale with two pans, one raised, one low, behind him. Sword: slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip bound in bone-white sinew-stitched cord, a plain iron cross guard bent at one tip, a grey felt scabbard clearly passed down from someone larger, a bone bead on a short horsehair tassel. Power: a faint ochre-gold glow clings to the lower pan. Background: a blurred winter yard with frost on stones, a girl in nomad braids in the distance. Light: cold pale silver morning light from the upper left. Expression: a sleepless, bloodshot stare with a tight, watchful mouth and shadows under the eyes.

people.imagined: On a terrace she lays one more dry-stone course, fitting a stone she has turned in her hands three times. The plait round her head is like a rope; she has no wish to pass the beam.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the top of a half-built dry-stone wall she settles a rough grey stone into its place with a satisfied little tap of her knuckle. Face: a calm, round, sun-browned face of about twenty-one; steady dark eyes watching the stone; level, thick brows; a short nose with a smear of dust; a small, content smile. Hair (most important: the rope-plait): black hair in one very thick plait wound round her head like a coil of rope, held by a plain bronze pin, plainly visible as a thick braided crown. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, strong forearms, kneeling with weight low. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and short sleeves rolled up, collars embroidered with a few small gold mountain ridges, soft dark silk pads bound over each knee, a cloth tied round the waist. Hands and objects: the knuckles of both hands are nicked and scabbed with small pale scars, clearly visible; the right hand tapping a stone; a plumb line with a stone bob hanging from the wall; a pile of sorted stones. Power: a soft ochre-gold light settles into the seams between the stones as each one is set, and a few golden motes drift up. Background: blurred terraces climbing a misty hillside, a section of tidy grey wall and a pale luminous sky. Light: warm gold afternoon light from the upper left with a soft rim on her coiled plait. Expression: a calm, absorbed face with lowered lids and a small satisfied smile, unhurried, with no wish to pass the beam.

people.imagined: On a plateau slope at morning he digs a milkvetch root with a small spade and holds it up, brown earth to the elbows. He is paid in pill dust and gives most of it away.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on a grassy plateau slope at morning he holds up a long pale milkvetch root from the earth, a shy, pleased smile on his face. Face: a mild, thin, brown face of about twenty-three; big gentle dark eyes; soft thin brows; a straight nose; a small shy smile; a smudge of earth on the chin; sunburnt cheeks and a few freckles on his nose. Hair: brown, short and unkempt, a bit of dry grass in it. Body: slim, a little stooped, soft hands. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars, sleeves rolled to the elbow, the knees of the robe stained with earth, a cloth bag on a silk strap across the chest. Hands and objects (the stained fingers must read): the fingers and nails of both hands are stained dark brown with root juice and earth, clearly visible; a long, pale, branching root in the right hand; a small wooden spade stuck in the ground; a basket of more roots with leaves at his knee. Power: the pale root glows softly like a lamp, a faint green wood light running through it, and a few green and ochre motes float up from the turned earth. Background: a blurred wide plateau slope with dry yellow grass, a few small flowers and distant misty peaks. Light: clear pearl-gold morning light from the upper left, the thin sun lighting the root. Expression: a shy, glad, gentle smile with soft eyes, the humble pleasure of a young man who gives most of what he digs away.

people.imagined: In the kitchen she is churning butter tea in a tall wooden churn, laughing so the churn seems to ring, a smear of butter on her sleeve. She is impatient to learn the weights with the churn.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a tall wooden butter-tea churn, she plunges the dasher up and down with both hands, laughing out loud with her head thrown back. Face: a bright, round, rosy young face of about sixteen; sparkling black eyes half shut in laughter; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide open laughing mouth showing a missing side tooth; cheeks round and shining with steam. Hair: black, in two short pigtails tied with scraps of white silk, bouncing, a few damp wisps clinging to her forehead. Body: small, sturdy, young, energetic, up on her toes. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of the youngest outer disciple of the Pivot: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and sleeves pushed up, a long pale silk work-wrap over it splashed with butter; the left sleeve has a shiny smear of yellow butter from wrist to elbow, clearly visible; wool socks and small wooden clogs. Hands and objects: both hands on the dasher of a tall, banded, dark-wood churn; a pale foamy tea line at the churn's lip; a steaming kettle and a stack of clay bowls on the table. Power: a few warm golden-ochre motes dance in the steam above the churn, as if the laugh were ringing them loose. Background: a blurred warm kitchen with a hearth, hanging pots and steam. Light: warm firelight from the lower left and soft steam haze with a pale gold rim on her cheek. Expression: a loud, bright laugh with the head thrown back and the whole face open, a girl who laughs like a bell and is itching to learn the weights.

people.imagined: At night by the great scale, spear-butt on the frost, red-rimmed night-guard eyes fixed. He tied a boy to the rack in the cold and he is still watching for the next one.
people.subject: The moment: standing guard at night beside a great bronze scale on a frosty stone ground, he stares unblinking at the viewer, spear planted. Face (most important: red-rimmed eyes): a hard, pale, square face of about thirty; deep-set dark eyes with raw, red, swollen rims from sleepless nights; thick straight black brows; a broad nose with white frost on the tip; a thick, flat, cruel mouth; a stubbled jaw. Hair: black, cropped, under a grey silk-wool cap pulled low. Body: broad, heavy, tall; planted square with shoulders hunched against the cold. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot, on a night watch: a pale earth-gold inner robe under an iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and tight sleeves, over it a heavy sheepskin-lined coat of cream-grey silk with a bronze-stitched border; wrapped leggings. Hands and objects: a long spear with a pale steel head, the butt planted on the frost, held in the right hand, on whose palm a hard yellow callus is visible; a small shuttered lantern at his sash; a coil of rope hanging on the rack beside him. Power: a pale ochre-gold glow gathers at the spear's butt on the frost, and a thin steel-silver mist hangs on the great scale. Background: a blurred night yard with the great scale's frame, white frost on the stones, a few stars. Light: cold blue moonlight from the upper left and a small yellow lantern from below. Expression: an unblinking red-rimmed stare with a hard mouth and a set jaw, watching for the next boy he can tie to the rack.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Kiều road at a run, mud to the knees though the weather has been dry, thin calves flashing, a letter in her fist. Her brother is betting on her time.
people.subject: The moment: running hard along a road in bright daylight, one foot airborne, a rolled letter gripped in her fist, her face set and focused. Face: a thin, hard-working, tanned face of about twenty-seven; steady dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, determined mouth; a line of sweat on the temple, cheeks flushed with effort, a wisp of hair clinging to her neck. Hair: black, in a tight plait pinned up at the nape with a silver pin, a little loose. Body: lean, long-legged, light, with the thin calves of a runner and long strides. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot, hitched up for the road: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars and short sleeves, tucked into the sash above the knees; both legs are caked in mud to the knee, clearly visible even on a dry road; silk-cord running shoes tied tight. Hands and objects: a small rolled letter with a blank wax seal in the right fist; a flat pouch bouncing at her hip; a small bone whistle on a cord. Power: a faint trail of ochre-gold light follows her heels and a puff of golden dust rises behind them, swift for her realm. Background: a blurred dry dusty road with roadside pines and a distant bridge in morning haze; long shadows of pine trunks stripe the road. Light: bright silver-gold daylight from the upper left. Expression: a set, narrow-eyed determination, lips closed and brow level, a runner thinking only of the road and not of her brother's wager.

people.imagined: On the Bridge Court steps he cannot keep his heels still, selling a whisper for a cake. His left sleeve is torn and tied with string; he looks round to see who has seen.
people.subject: The moment: perched on a stone step he drums his heels restlessly and leans close, one hand cupped to whisper, eyes darting sideways at the viewer. Face: a thin, quick, street-bred face of about twenty-five; bright darting dark eyes; thin arched brows; a pointed nose; a mobile mouth caught in a half-grin; a small scar through the left eyebrow; a smudge of sweet rice flour dusting his upper lip. Hair: black, messy, tied up with a bit of silk cord, a few tufts sticking out. Body: wiry, small, restless, heels bouncing, his shoulders hunched conspiratorially as he leans forward. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple of the Pivot, clean but not careful: a pale earth-gold inner robe under a light iron-grey gauze over-robe with crossed collars; the left sleeve is ripped at the shoulder and tied back with a bit of twine, plainly visible, a street boy's habit he has never bothered to break; a flat silk messenger pouch slung across the chest; dark shoes with a split toe. Hands and objects: a rolled summons tied with a grey cord held in the left hand; the right hand cupped to the mouth; half a sweet rice cake in the pouch. Power: a few small ochre and steel-silver motes flit round his cupped hand like loose gossip. Background: blurred wide stone steps of the Bridge Court in mist, a crowd of listeners sitting, a pillar. Light: bright pearl-gold daylight from the upper left. Expression: a quick, mobile, cheeky half-grin with bright darting eyes, the look of a boy who has just sold a whisper for a cake and is checking who saw.
